title: e76 lower onset of summer convection, alone and with e75 C05 (declared before any e76 run)
made_after: e75 C05 fixes westerly lee basins but fails dev49 (S49 1.015; refit best 1.012) because summer and inland totals are already too low (US Midwest summer 65 vs 93 mm). reports/SUMMER_RAIN_20261030.md: mid-latitude summer convection nearly absent, the v6 instability boost starts at 22 C.
mechanism: instability_t0 replaces the fixed 22 C onset of the v6 boost (same 8 C ramp, same moisture gate). Default 22 keeps r44 byte-identical.
gate: policy_v3 dev49 (S49<=0.995, T and P not worse than +1%) + fine28 against r44; no further variants without a new amendment. A passer goes to sealed set i only with the owner's release.
result: J1 S49 1.0142, J2 1.0263, J3 1.045: all FAIL (fine28 pass). J1 helps us_midwest -18%, japan -19%, texas_plains -11% but hurts east_australia +43%, tripolitania +38%, victoria +18%, north_queensland +15%, east_china +14%: surface warmth is the wrong trigger.

amendment_1.made_after: J1 S49 1.0142, J2 1.0263, J3 1.045: all FAIL (fine28 pass). J1 helps us_midwest -18%, japan -19%, texas_plains -11% but hurts east_australia +43%, tripolitania +38%, victoria +18%, north_queensland +15%, east_china +14%: surface warmth is the wrong trigger.
amendment_1.change: e77 storm_convection: instab += k x storm index x clip((T-15)/8,0,1) x moisture (default 0, r44 byte-identical). Candidates K1 k=0.5, K2 k=1.0, alone (no e75); same gate. If one passes dev49, it is retried with e75 C05 as one further candidate.
amendment_1.result: K1 S49 1.0001, K2 1.0018: FAIL (neutral; fine28 pass). K2 helps us_midwest -11%, japan -9%, south_brazil -5%; hurts manchuria, victoria, east_australia +8-9%, tripolitania +8%, north_china_plain/eastern_europe +6%. No combination with e75 (rule: only after a dev49 pass).
